body: Quick pass @ 38875bbc: merges cleanly with main; quick gate green (app lib + 9 suites) plus the release heavy-lane pin; `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings` clean; body complete (cap rule and why not scaled, fallback rule with the continuity proof and the parameter-range condition that keeps sc_logo refused, pins + mutations, real-file timings: 10208 at 60 M imports again with main's exact facet count, sc_logo refused by name in ~15 s, Changelog, Fixes #1568). Flagged ready for review (safety tier).

Two notes from a read of head 38875bbc, in addition to the review already on this PR:

1. The 150 M cap is per face and per pass, and there is no shell-wide budget. One pass can therefore cost (number of runaway faces) x 150 M evaluations, which is 6x the old 25 M per face. A hostile file with many degenerate faces could cost many times the 10-15 s measured for one face. It still terminates and memory stays small, so this is not a hang. A cumulative cap per pass or shell would bound it, and could be a follow-up issue. Edge-curve divisions are still unmetered (#1545).
2. The next head will conflict with #1576 in `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs` and `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs`. The `step.rs` hunk is the `triangulate` closure now returning `PassError`, so whichever PR merges second needs a hand read when it is refreshed. A trial merge with #1574 is clean.

Review fix pushed: b518c907 (re pullrequestreview-5899510189)

**Blocking items**
1. **Multi-trip hole** - fixed. `Guarded::tripped()` now walks every tripped face: the pass counts as continuous only if every tripped face is proven and was never divided outside its range; otherwise the trip reported (and the refusal) names the first tripped face that is not. Pinned by `step_guard::tests::a_proven_and_a_jumping_face_tripping_in_one_pass_refuse_naming_the_jump`: on the `bspline_discontinuous.step` shell, meter 0 (plane, proven) alone gives `continuous: true`; meters 0 and 5 together give `Trip { index: 5, "B-spline surface", continuous: false }`; and through `step_refine::refine` (pass 1 meets, pass 2 trips both) the schedule refuses naming "face 6 of". Killed by the first-trip-only mutant.
2. **`Meter::reset()`** - the out-of-range flag is now sticky for the whole import; `reset()` restores only the evaluation budget. A face any pass divided outside its range is never proven for a later trip, so a fallback never keeps a wild coarser pass. Pinned by `an_earlier_pass_outside_the_range_voids_a_later_trip` (wild pass, reset, in-range trip -> not continuous); `a_division_outside_the_surface_range_is_flagged` now asserts the flag survives `reset()`.
3. **Range clause unpinned** - `a_trip_on_a_proven_face_divided_outside_its_range_is_not_continuous`: a rational degree-(2,2) patch with positive weights (sc_logo #836's shape) as a one-face shell, divided in range -> trip `continuous: true`; divided over u from -2e51 -> `continuous: false`. Killed by the `tripped_ignores_range` mutant. No user file committed.

**Survivors** - all killed now:
- NURBS x/y/z finiteness, `w.is_finite()`: `a_nurbs_with_a_non_finite_coordinate_or_weight_is_not_proven` (an infinite w alone is also caught by the new weight floor, so the w pin uses a net whose weights are all infinite).
- knot finiteness: `a_non_finite_knot_is_not_proven` (infinite end knot; a NaN knot cannot be built, truck's `KnotVec::from` sorts with `partial_cmp().unwrap()`).
- `within` finiteness: `a_non_finite_division_range_is_never_within`. In the importer it is unreachable (B-spline/NURBS ranges are bounded, so the comparisons already reject a non-finite range); the pin holds the function's contract against an unbounded range.
- swept proven: `a_swept_surface_is_not_proven` (an extruded line).

**Notes**
- Remedy text: `Kept` carries `eval_capped`; the reduced-fidelity log line now says "a finer pass ran past a face's evaluation cap (a larger facet budget will not help)". The user-facing refusals (`model_fidelity.rs:58/:270/:311`) still say "larger STEP facet budget": only the chord is stored on `ReducedFidelity` and saved with the project, so carrying the cause needs a stored field and a format bump - filed as #1592 (P7).
- Weight floor adopted: a NURBS weight below 1e-9 of the net's largest is not proven. Pinned by `a_near_zero_weight_relative_to_the_net_is_not_proven` (1e-12 refused, 1e-6 proven); recorded in `docs/decisions/1568-step-cap-headroom.md`.

**Mutation check** (each applied, `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib -- geometry::import`, reverted): first-trip-only, `reset()` clears outside, `tripped()` ignores outside, `within` finiteness, NURBS x/y/z finiteness, NURBS `w.is_finite()`, weight floor dropped, knot finiteness, swept proven, `eval_capped` never set - **10/10 killed**.

**Real files** (release `camcraft-cli mcp` `import_model`, this head; local only): `sc_logo.step` refused by name (`face #836 (NURBS surface, face 9 of 62 in shell #3148) ... did not converge within 150000000 evaluations (a discontinuous or degenerate surface)`, 14.9 s); `10208.STEP` at 60 M imports **14,866,333 facets** (225.6 s, with the debug gate and clippy running on the same machine for part of it); `h5.step` imports, 84 facets.

**Gate**: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` green, 58 s (app lib 221 + 1 ignored, import_step_guard 6, the other import suites unchanged); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` clean. The branch still merges cleanly with upstream/main (no merge taken).

Still a draft; not marked ready.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** One note: the head still conflicts with #1576 in the import files (below), which a merge-time refresh handles.

## What I checked in b518c9076 (the review fix)
Items from the earlier requested-changes review:
1. Two faces tripping in one pass: `Guarded::tripped()` (step_guard.rs ~270) now walks every tripped face. The pass is continuous only if every tripped face is proven, otherwise the first non-proven face is reported and named. Pinned by `a_proven_and_a_jumping_face_tripping_in_one_pass_refuse_naming_the_jump`, which also drives it through `refine` and expects a named refusal.
2. Range clause across passes: `outside` is now sticky (`reset()` no longer clears it), so the pass whose mesh would be kept cannot hide a wild division. Pinned by `an_earlier_pass_outside_the_range_voids_a_later_trip`.
3. Range clause at composition level: `a_trip_on_a_proven_face_divided_outside_its_range_is_not_continuous` (same rational degree-(2,2) shape as sc_logo's face #836, in range vs u from -2e51).
Also added: relative NURBS weight floor (1e-9 of the net's largest), tests for non-finite coordinate/weight/knot, a swept surface not proven, and the reduced-fidelity log now says a larger budget will not help after a cap fallback (`Kept::eval_capped`).

## Hang guard / untrusted files
Not weakened. The 150 M per-face cap and the metered collapse are untouched. Every change in this commit only makes the fallback rarer (more trips count as "may jump" and refuse by name) - sticky flag, all-faces rule, weight floor. A pass never keeps a smeared mesh on a face that may jump; first-pass trips always refuse. No unwrap, expect or panic added; `tripped()` uses `get`/`unwrap_or`.

## Shell-wide budget (my earlier note)
Follow-up, not blocking. Per face the cost is 150 M evaluations (measured 7-10 s refusal in the author's own review, run on a worker thread, bounded, memory small); across faces it grows with faces / cores, as before this PR at 25 M. Suggested issue (P7, area import, not filed by me): "STEP: pass-wide evaluation budget" - stop a tessellation pass once the summed evaluations of tripped faces pass a few caps, and meter edge-curve divisions (#1545).

## Overlap
#1574: clean trial merge. #1576: still conflicts in `import/mod.rs` and `import/step.rs` (the `triangulate` closure now returns `PassError`); whichever merges second needs a hand read at merge-time refresh.

## Results merged with main
On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43529363736, success, merged with main be27a4c7: quick gate green (app suites, 90 s, 0 failed) and clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings clean. Not built locally. No cfg(windows) readings in the diff.

## Requested before merge
None from the read.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
